baseline.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -count=1 -v ./internal/app -run "TestKeywordPollingBaseline|TestManualPollRequestIsCoalescedAndRejectedDuringBackoff|Test.*(DetailCap|Cap)"'

package-gates.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -count=1 ./internal/app ./internal/store ./internal/telegram'

green.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 -v ./internal/app -run TestKeywordPolling'

race-build.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 ./internal/app ./internal/store ./internal/telegram; CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/somonwatch-nocgo ./cmd/somonwatch'
race-build.basis: supporting pre-final snapshot; only later delta removes keyword 404 terminal rejection
